title: Idea partition record
description: The machine-readable twin of one partition sweep's markdown document. The partition-ideas skill writes it next to idea-partition-<corpus date>.md, with the same basename and a .json extension, carrying the same tracks, member ids and manifest seed as the markdown, so a downstream reader takes the partition from this record rather than parsing prose. A track is one level-2 programme: one prospective plan. The record is a proposal until the owner accepts it at the final gate; `state` says which.

idea_id.description: A six-digit idea id from the idea log.

group.description: One level-1 fine group: a set the partition criterion says must be implemented together.

corpus_date.description: The corpus's build date: the modification date of the corpus manifest, which records none of its own. The markdown's filename carries the same date.

markdown.description: Path of the markdown document this record accompanies, relative to the top level of the checkout that holds it: the staging directory while the partition is a draft, the partitions directory once it is accepted. A numeric suffix appears only when an earlier partition document already holds the same corpus date.

manifest.description: The corpus the partition was built from, copied from the corpus manifest so the record traces to its slice.

status.description: The idea statuses the corpus was selected by (idea_corpus.py build --status).

shuffle_seed.description: The seed the corpus build drew and recorded. It identifies one sweep: the run stamp on every file the sweep writes carries it.

state.description: proposed=written at synthesis, before the owner has ruled | accepted=the owner accepted the partition at the final gate. Only the owner's acceptance moves it; the skill never writes accepted on its own judgement.

tracks.description: The level-2 programmes, each with its level-1 fine groups underneath.

disposition.description: The owner's new-plan-or-amendment ruling for this track, once one is made. Null until then: the partition pack asks for none, so a sweep leaves it empty rather than inventing one.

plan.description: For an amendment, the document id or code of the plan being amended.

unbatched.description: Ideas with no confident home, each with its reason. Every corpus idea is in exactly one track group or here.

decline_candidates.description: The two decline tiers from the synthesis protocol. A nomination only: nothing here changes an idea's status, and the owner rules on each at the final gate. A decline candidate still appears in a group or in unbatched.
